#include <iostream>
#include <fstream>
#include <algorithm>
#include <unordered_map>

using namespace std;

using llong = long long;

llong dp_arr[20];

int recursive_solver( llong value, int depth )
{
   llong quotient = value / dp_arr[depth];

   if ( value % dp_arr[depth] == 0 )
            return depth * quotient;

   int option_x = depth * quotient + recursive_solver( value % dp_arr[depth], depth - 1 );
   int option_y = depth * ( quotient + 1 ) + recursive_solver( dp_arr[depth] - ( value % dp_arr[depth] ), depth - 1 );

   return min( option_x, option_y );
}

int main()
{
    dp_arr[1] = 1;

    for ( int idx = 2; idx <= 17; ++idx )
    {
        dp_arr[idx] = dp_arr[idx - 1] * 10LL + 1;
    }

    llong input_val;

    cin >> input_val;
    cout << recursive_solver( input_val, 17 );

    return 0;
}
